Summary: USER_CONTEXT: Investigating a heap-use-after-free vulnerability in libxml2's XInclude processing (xmlXIncludeLoadDoc frees source document while copied nodes may still reference its namespaces)

COMPLETED: 
- Examined xmlXIncludeCopyNodeList/xmlXIncludeCopyNode in xinclude.c (lines 811-1000)
- Examined xmlStaticCopyNode in tree.c (lines 4192-4345) - confirmed it copies nsDef via xmlCopyNamespaceList and creates new ns via xmlNewNs when not found in target
- Examined xmlXIncludeRecurseDoc (lines 661-720) - recursion handling
- Examined xmlXIncludeLoadNode (lines 2018-2175) - full load flow
- Examined xmlXIncludeLoadFallback (lines 1949-2018) - fallback handling
- Located xmlCopyNamespaceList at tree.c line 4008

PENDING:
- Examine xmlCopyNamespaceList implementation (tree.c lines 3973-4013)
- Identify exact use-after-free scenario in xmlXIncludeLoadDoc (line 1771)
- Determine root cause and implement fix

CURRENT_STATE:
- Working directory: /workspace
- Repository: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/
- Key files: xinclude.c, tree.c
- Key functions: xmlXIncludeLoadDoc (line 1771 frees doc when count<=1), xmlStaticCopyNode (copies namespaces), xmlXIncludeLoadFallback (directly assigns fallback->children without copying)

CODE_STATE:
- File: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/xinclude.c
  - xmlXIncludeCopyNodeList (line ~811): copies nodes via xmlDocCopyNode with extended=1
  - xmlXIncludeLoadDoc (line ~1771): xmlFreeDoc(ctxt->incTab[nr]->doc) when count<=1
  - xmlXIncludeLoadFallback (line ~1949): ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc = fallback->children (direct reference, no copy)
- File: /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/tree.c
  - xmlStaticCopyNode (line 4192): copies nsDef, creates new ns if not found in target
  - xmlCopyNamespaceList (line 4008): copies namespace list

TESTS: No tests run yet - still in analysis phase

CHANGES: No code changes made yet

DEPS: libxml2 source code (xinclude.c, tree.c)

VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS: Repository at /workspace/repo-vul, branch not specified
